facts.function: infant sleepwear/playwear, bodysuit plus stretchsuit plus bib
facts.form: set of pieces (described as 2 pc set with bib)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6111 covers babies' garments and clothing accessories, knitted, of cotton
GRI 3(b)/statistical set provision: garments put up together as a set are classified in the 'Sets' line, 6111.20.60.20

rejected_alternatives.reason: sunsuits, washsuits and similar apparel is for a single garment not imported as a set
bib alone would fall here (N014992) but this is a set
bodysuits of other garment heading; babies' garments go to 6111 (chapter 61 note on babies' garments up to size 86cm)
imported as parts of sets is for pieces imported separately

missing_facts: Whether the pieces are packaged together for retail sale and worn together (N014992 separated a gift set whose pieces were not worn together)
classification.rationale: All items are finely knit cotton babies' garments, so heading 6111 and 6111.20 apply under GRI 1. Ruling N014992 shows a mixed gift set whose items are not worn together splits into separate lines; here the bodysuit and stretchsuit are a coordinated sleep-and-play set, so the 'Sets' line 6111.20.60.20 is used, as in M87250-type outcomes.
